cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat
cards.description: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak
cards.description: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.description: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Regice
cards.description: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

cards.name: Shellos
cards.description: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu
cards.description: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude
cards.description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.description: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist
cards.description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

cards.name: Regirock
cards.description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Gastrodon
cards.description: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Registeel
cards.description: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.description: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

cards.name: Miltank
cards.description: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

cards.name: Regigigas
cards.description: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.description: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
